sentences.text: Lorsque le notaire ouvrit le testament, l'assistance retint son souffle.
sentences.translation: When the notary opened the will, those present held their breath.

sentences.text: Le vieux Berthier, réputé avare jusqu'à la caricature, avait amassé une fortune considérable.
sentences.translation: Old Berthier, famed for a miserliness verging on caricature, had amassed a considerable fortune.

sentences.text: Chacun, parmi les héritiers, escomptait en secret la part du lion.
sentences.translation: Each of the heirs secretly reckoned on the lion's share.

sentences.text: Or le défunt, en guise d'ultime pied de nez, léguait l'intégralité de ses biens à son chat.
sentences.translation: But the deceased, by way of a final thumbing of the nose, bequeathed the entirety of his estate to his cat.

sentences.text: Un silence consterné succéda à la stupeur première.
sentences.translation: A dismayed silence followed the initial shock.

sentences.text: « Quoi qu'il en soit, précisa le notaire, la clause est parfaitement valable. »
sentences.translation: "Be that as it may," the notary specified, "the clause is perfectly valid."

sentences.text: Les neveux, naguère si prévenants, quittèrent la pièce en maugréant.
sentences.translation: The nephews, once so attentive, left the room grumbling.

sentences.text: Seule la gouvernante, désignée pour veiller sur l'animal, esquissa un sourire.
sentences.translation: Only the housekeeper, appointed to look after the animal, allowed herself a faint smile.

sentences.text: Car elle, et elle seule, savait combien le vieil homme avait su, à sa manière, récompenser la fidélité.
sentences.translation: For she, and she alone, knew how well the old man had, in his own way, rewarded loyalty.

glossary.translation: a thumbing of the nose (gesture of mockery)
be that as it may (subjunctive set phrase)

questions.question: To whom did Berthier leave his fortune?
Why did the housekeeper smile?
options: She understood the old man had rewarded loyalty through her

sentences.text: Le théâtre, ce soir-là, affichait complet, comme aux plus belles heures de sa gloire.
sentences.translation: The theatre, that evening, was sold out, as in the finest hours of its glory.

sentences.text: Sur la scène, la vieille comédienne savait que ce serait là son ultime rôle.
sentences.translation: On the stage, the old actress knew this would be her final role.

sentences.text: Nul, dans la salle, ne se doutait que la maladie la rongeait depuis des mois.
sentences.translation: No one in the auditorium suspected that illness had been gnawing at her for months.

sentences.text: Elle déclama son texte avec une intensité que nul, jadis, ne lui avait connue.
sentences.translation: She declaimed her lines with an intensity no one had ever known in her before.

sentences.text: Chaque réplique semblait arrachée non au personnage, mais à elle-même.
sentences.translation: Each line seemed wrested not from the character, but from herself.

sentences.text: Quand le rideau tomba, un silence sacré précéda l'ovation.
sentences.translation: When the curtain fell, a sacred silence preceded the ovation.

sentences.text: On la rappela sept fois ; sept fois, elle s'inclina, le visage baigné de larmes.
sentences.translation: She was called back seven times; seven times she bowed, her face bathed in tears.

sentences.text: Personne ne comprit que ces applaudissements tenaient lieu, pour elle, d'adieu.
sentences.translation: No one understood that this applause served, for her, as a farewell.

sentences.text: Elle s'éteignit trois jours plus tard, emportant avec elle le secret de sa dernière flamme.
sentences.translation: She passed away three days later, taking with her the secret of her last flame.

glossary.translation: to pass away (lit. to go out, of a flame)

questions.question: What did the actress know about this performance?
options: It would be her final role

questions.question: What did the audience fail to understand?
options: That the applause was her farewell
